title: THE OUTSIDERS (BY WILLIAM THORNDIKE)
transcript: This is how newspapers picture the greatest CEOs of our time. Someone who is charismatic and action-oriented. In this video, I will present the five most important traits that an outstanding CEO possesses based on my own opinion after reading the book, The Outsiders, which is written by William Thorndike. This is the Swedish investor, bringing you the best tips and tools to reach financial freedom through stock market investing. Trait number one: They are skilled investors.
